reviews.title: Stop Making Gmail Worse With Every Update!
reviews.text:
I’ve used Gmail for years, and I’m sick of Google taking something that worked perfectly well and making it unnecessarily complicated.

The latest iPhone redesign is a perfect example of terrible user experience.

Previously, I could select my personal email account, view all my accounts in one combined inbox, and automatically reply from whichever account received the message. It was simple, intuitive, and efficient.

Now the left-hand menu is an overwhelming mess of “All accounts,” individual accounts, dropdown arrows, repeated folders, and unnecessary navigation. Collapsing sections doesn’t fix the problem. Why make something so straightforward so confusing?

And that’s not the only problem with this redesign:

* The oversized borders, rounded message cards, and unnecessary spacing waste valuable screen space.
* The cluttered layout makes emails harder to scan quickly.
* The distinction between read and unread messages has become less visually obvious.
* Account switching and navigation feel needlessly complicated.
* Google keeps adding AI features, suggestions, categories, and other distractions when many of us just want an efficient email application.
* There is no simple option to restore the previous interface.
* Google’s feedback system offers virtually no accountability, acknowledgment, or meaningful response to complaints.

Not every update is an improvement. Changing an interface just for the sake of changing it is not innovation.

reviews.title: Issue: WhatsApp Missing from iOS Share Sheet When Sharing Gmail PDF Attachments
reviews.text:
Device: iPhone 12 Pro Max
iOS: Latest available version
Gmail account: Personal Gmail
Location: India

Description:

I am unable to share PDF attachments directly from the Gmail iOS app to WhatsApp because WhatsApp does not appear in the iOS Share Sheet.

When I open a PDF attachment in Gmail and tap the Share icon, only four applications appear:

* Gmail
* Google Drive
* Microsoft Teams
* Google Chrome

WhatsApp is completely missing, including under the Edit/More options.

Troubleshooting already performed:

1. Offloaded and reinstalled WhatsApp.
2. Removed and reinstalled Gmail.
3. Restarted the iPhone.
4. Verified that WhatsApp is installed and functioning correctly.

Additional testing:

WhatsApp appears correctly when sharing PDFs through:

* Apple Files app.
* Safari.
* Other applications, including Google Meet invitations.

I also tested Gmail Web through Safari. WhatsApp appears there when sharing the same type of PDF attachment.

Interestingly, my cousin using an iPhone 11 Pro can share Gmail PDF attachments directly to WhatsApp.

Expected behaviour:

WhatsApp should appear as a sharing destination when sharing PDF attachments directly from the Gmail iOS app.

Actual behaviour:

WhatsApp is missing only from Gmail’s attachment-sharing interface.

Please investigate this Gmail iOS attachment-sharing compatibility issue.

reviews.title: October 2026 redesign is a clear step backwards!
reviews.text:
The new card-based inbox makes Gmail worse to use every day. Each email now sits in its own box with thick margins and padding, so far fewer messages fit on the screen. An inbox is a tool for scanning and triaging quickly, and this layout forces constant scrolling just to see what used to be visible at a glance.

Readability has also gotten worse. The boxes break the visual flow, the contrast between cards and background is weak in dark mode, and the extra borders add clutter without adding any information. It looks unfinished and out of place next to the rest of iOS, which feels clean and cohesive.

The worst part is that there is no option to go back. A change this big to the core screen of the app should come with a toggle, or at least a density setting (compact/default/comfortable), as Gmail on the web already offers. Forcing it on every user with no alternative suggests user feedback wasn't part of the process.

Please bring back the previous list layout, or add a compact view. Until that happens, I’m switching to Outlook for my email. A redesign that-pushes long time users to a competitor isn’t an improvement.

reviews.title: Irrecoverable failure at basics
reviews.text:
This app has degraded into complete slop and the team pushes out minor UI changes rather than actually delivering a stable, secure app that serves even the most basic functions it could easily do over a decade ago. I just spent an hour writing a long email to my grandfather after my grandmother’s passing and hit send, the email confirmed as sent and then I went to the sent folder to make sure it was there and it was not and “! Error” appears on the screen then every few seconds repeating again “! ERROR” “! Error” I quickly go to safari and check to make sure I have internet and I do everything loads fine. I clicked around hoping it recovers but the app just keeps going “! Error” “! Error” again and again. I go to my laptop and try Gmail there and fortunately a two-thirds completed copy is there in drafts. I spend another fifteen minutes re-writing the lost part of the email before sending again. Never drafting in Gmail anything beyond a sentence or two again. The 
Gmail team should be ashamed, the managers and executives should be fired. There used to be an engineering culture at Google. It’s literally trivial to save text locally on an iPhone, the fact they could lose two paragraphs of text and fail so terribly at the most basic of function of an email client is just incomprehensible.

reviews.title: Latest updates broke iPad variant
reviews.text: Gmail has been a good app for such a long time.  Unfortunately lately it has been going downhill.  Some (advanced) features are just not working.  Like, when on an iPad (landscape) in “All Inboxes” performing actions (using left hand set of action icons) on multiple emails across several accounts no longer works - the action only works on current account’s emails. That is, 1) When someone has multiple different gmail accounts setup, working within the combined universal “All Inboxes”, Select multiple emails across several accounts and perform any action on these emails from the main window (e.g. mark as read, delete) - that action only gets performed on the current active focused email, not the selected emails.  If one selects one of the limited actions from the icons on the left above the folders list (landscape view) that action is performed across the selected emails. This is new & odd behaviour. Both sets of icons once did and still should work the same. 2) Also you can not select multiple emails from the same account and perform actions, like set Labels, across these multiple emails. You can only do it one email at a time via the right side icon set. And 3) the “Select All” option that appears on the first email select, makes the screen change shifting the list and therefore the position where you may tap on the next email — this too is unwelcome new behaviour. Then it will randomly stop loading more emails, at which point I usually just revert to desktop. The formatting issue that causes text pasted into a draft to randomly change size - but for this to only be visible once the email is sent, egregiously so on desktop - is another dealbreaker.
